title: add profiling baselines and representative workload runners (v36)
author: Ava Chen
description: Adds v36 of the benchmark-lab profiling baselines and a set of representative workload runners plus updated reporting pipeline hooks. Motivation: bring profiling priors up-to-date with the latest runtime batching and kv-cache changes to produce stable baselines for nightly regressions and cost analyses. What changed: 1) new profiling baselines for 4096/2048/512 sequence length distributions (yaml configs and baseline artifacts); 2) representative runners for text-generation, chat-streaming, and embedding microbenchmarks (python runners with standardized CLI and metrics emission); 3) reporting pipeline updates to ingest new baseline metadata and publish summary CSV/Parquet to the reporting bucket; 4) CI/workflow updates to validate runner smoke-tests and artifact upload; 5) docs and quickstart for running baselines locally. Testing: included unit tests for the runner CLI, integration smoke tests in GH actions that run a single short-profile on a CPU/GPU matrix, and a dry-run of the reporting pipeline against a staging bucket. Rollout plan: merged to main, nightly job will start using v36 baselines next deploy; older baselines retained for historical comparisons. Checklist: - [x] baseline configs added; - [x] runner tests and linting; - [x] reporting pipeline schema bump; - [x] docs updated; - [x] Linear tickets referenced. Related: ENG-4987 (profiling orchestration), ENG-5021 (reporting schema).
